Ayodhya Ram Mandir Trust to Appoint First CEO

The Ayodhya Ram Mandir Trust is scheduled to hold a significant meeting today where the appointment of the first Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is likely to be announced. This decision marks a key step in the operationalization of the temple trust. Both English and Hindi media outlets are reporting on the impending announcement, highlighting its importance for the temple's future management.
